title: Eighteenmile Creek complete EPA ECHO reporting-period and annual history
notes: All 70 original source responses and thirteen CSV primaries. Keep original annual row multiplicity and nonnumeric/future period records. Physical subtotals sum available EPA-calculated mass for periods ending in each reporting year by capture; no extrapolation or cross-year proration. Non-mass indicator/color rows carry no kilogram subtotal. The current-year source and current 2023 science companion remain explicit.
